items.hed: The Houston Texans are coming off Thursday's 26-3 blowout of the Indianapolis Colts at Reliant Stadium and now have an extended break before their next game, a Week 12 home matchup against the Baltimore Ravens on Sunday, Nov. 29
items.insight: C.J. Stroud threw for three touchdowns in the Thursday night win, and the Texans held Indianapolis without a touchdown for the first time since 2024, according to the team's own schedule page. With no game this week, Houston's coaching staff continues extra preparation before hosting Baltimore in Week 12, with full broadcast and streaming information carried on the team's official site.
items.image_caption: NRG Stadium (formerly Reliant Stadium), Houston. Venue still.

items.hed: Astros first baseman Christian Walker turned missing out on a 2025 Gold Glove Award into motivation, reworking his first-step quickness and positioning in Spring Training to win his fourth career Gold Glove in 2026 with a league-leading .997 fielding percentage
items.insight: Walker told MLB.com he used the 2025 snub — after winning three straight Gold Gloves with Arizona — to get back to basics with Houston's run-prevention and field coordinators, and the work showed: he played 154 games and 1,299 2/3 innings at first base, more than any other Astro at any position, and didn't commit his first error until the ninth inning of an Aug. 21 game, snapping a 121-game errorless streak that was the longest in the majors this year. Walker said he tries not to fixate on numbers during the season, focusing instead on being 'a good defender that helps the team' and 'picking up my infielders.'
items.image_caption: Daikin Park (formerly Minute Maid Park), 2010. Venue still.

items.hed: The Houston Rockets, coming off a 133-124 loss at Denver on Friday in which the Nuggets' Nikola Jokic posted 26 points, 11 assists and seven rebounds, host the Los Angeles Clippers at Toyota Center tonight with tip-off scheduled for 8:30 p.m. ET
items.insight: The Friday loss split the season series with Denver after Houston had beaten the Nuggets earlier this month, with the result counting in both the regular-season column and Emirates NBA Cup West Group A standings, according to the league's own box-score pages. Tonight's home game against the Clippers is the Rockets' next scheduled matchup, with broadcast and ticket information on the team's official schedule page.
